sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: No Limit to Perfection - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Soft types don't last long in the Arena, so you better stay in shape! We've got a big iron here, try handling that beast if you've got the strength for it. And if you don't, drag your ass to the gym and keep at it until you do!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 10 enemies while using an RSh-12

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +15,000 EXP
- +100 Strength skill points
- 10 GP coins
- 1× Valuables crate (Rare)

sections.text:
